en.headline: Explosive ordnance team clears suspicious object at Sham Shui Po construction site
en.dek: Police said a worker reported a 200mm object opposite the sports ground around noon on Friday, and the site was later declared safe.
body: Police and the Explosive Ordnance Disposal unit attended a construction site opposite Sham Shui Po Sports Ground on Friday after a worker reported a suspicious object.
The report came in at about 12:58 p.m. The object measured roughly 200 millimetres long and 60 millimetres wide and was treated as a possible explosive, police said.
Officers confirmed the item on site. The Explosive Ordnance Disposal team conducted an examination while fire services stood by. The scene was later declared safe and the cordon lifted.

The site forms part of an Urban Renewal Authority redevelopment near the sports ground that is planned to include an 18-storey multi-purpose building, relocation of sports facilities and new recreational areas.
No injuries were reported. Police have not released further details on the nature of the object.

zh.headline: 深水埗運動場對開地盤發現可疑物體 爆炸品處理課到場後解封
zh.dek: 工人中午約12時58分報案，指發現長約200毫米的物體，警方及爆炸品處理課到場調查後宣布安全。
body: 深水埗運動場對開一個地盤周五中午有工人發現可疑物體，警方及爆炸品處理課到場處理。
報案時間約為中午12時58分。物體長約200毫米、闊約60毫米，初步懷疑是爆炸品。
警員到場確認後，爆炸品處理課人員進行檢查，消防亦到場戒備。調查後現場已安全解封。
該地盤屬市建局在運動場附近的重建項目範圍，計劃興建18層高聯用大樓，並重置康樂設施及增設休憩用地。
事件無人受傷。警方暫未公布物體的進一步性質。
